source_title: Arrow Pro-Race Slip-On Exhaust for Ducati Scrambler Cafe Racer
description: At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead… • Includes link pipe. • Increased horsepower and torque. • Significant weight savings over stock muffler. • Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger.
source_description_html:
At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead incorporated the muffler into the mid-pipe itself. This design not only reduces mass but also overall weight. Now this same design is available to you in the form of the Arrow Pro-Race Exhaust.

From its cone-shaped sleeve, angled round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Available in either titanium or NiChrome. NiChrome alloy is a blend of stainless steel and nickle alloy that is highly heat and corrosion-resistant. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

Features:

  • Includes link pipe
  • Increased horsepower and torque
  • Significant weight savings over stock muffler
  • Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger

At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead incorporated the muffler into the mid-pipe itself. This design not only reduces mass but also overall weight. Now this same design is available to you in the form of the Arrow Pro-Race Exhaust.

From its cone-shaped sleeve, angled round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Available in either titanium or NiChrome. NiChrome alloy is a blend of stainless steel and nickle alloy that is highly heat and corrosion-resistant. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

  • Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger

This design not only reduces mass but also overall weight. Now, this same design is available to you in the form of the Arrow Pro-Race Exhaust.

From its cone-shaped sleeve, round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

Not all exhaust pipes are made equal, the Arrow headers and mid-pipes bear all of Arrow’s experience accumulated from world class racing. That experience has lead Arrow’s to fine tune each part of their design and manufacturing processes. Everything from pipes diameters, sections bends, components, welding and layout are carefully tested to produce a product with high performance, reliability and last but not least, good looks.

Arrow's exhaust technologies are a direct result of their research and development through racing in MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, World Superbike and countless Enduro Rallies.

• Increased horsepower and torque

• Significant weight savings over stock muffler

• Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger

At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead incorporated the muffler into the mid-pipe itself. From its cone-shaped sleeve, angled round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Available in either titanium or NiChrome. NiChrome alloy is a blend of stainless steel and nickle alloy that is highly heat and corrosion-resistant. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

source_description_html:
At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead incorporated the muffler into the mid-pipe itself. This design not only reduces mass but also overall weight. Now this same design is available to you in the form of the Arrow Pro-Race Exhaust.

From its cone-shaped sleeve, angled round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Available in either titanium or NiChrome. NiChrome alloy is a blend of stainless steel and nickle alloy that is highly heat and corrosion-resistant. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

  • Significant weight savings over stock muffler
  • Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger

source_description_html:
At the turn of the 21st century, MotoGP saw a revolution in exhaust design that strayed away from old school round canister shapes and instead incorporated the muffler into the mid-pipe itself. This design not only reduces mass but also overall weight. Now this same design is available to you in the form of the Arrow Pro-Race Exhaust.

From its cone-shaped sleeve, angled round end cap, integrated exhaust hanger and TIG welding all around, this exhaust screams performance without compromise. Available in either titanium or NiChrome. NiChrome alloy is a blend of stainless steel and nickle alloy that is highly heat and corrosion-resistant. Because of the internal volume and shape of the Arrow Pro-Race, Arrow was not able to produce it for every single motorcycle. Arrow found through research that most bikes exceeded acceptable noise levels when fitted with the Pro-Race Exhaust. If your motorcycle is among the chosen few, consider yourself lucky.

Features:

  • Increased horsepower and torque
  • Significant weight savings over stock muffler
  • Integrated TIG welded exhaust hanger
